formations.name: Tipam
formations.description: Tipam formation is the primary reservoir target in the Duliajan Field. It comprises alternating sandstone and shale layers with moderate porosity and permeability. The fractured zones within Tipam are prone to mud losses. High overbalance in the permeable sandstone intervals leads to differential sticking. Reactive shale interbeds cause torque spikes.

formations.name: Barail
formations.description: Barail formation is an overpressured sandstone reservoir with significant gas accumulations. The transition from Tipam to Barail is marked by a pore pressure ramp, requiring careful mud weight management to prevent kicks. Formation pressure can exceed hydrostatic by 15-25% without warning.

formations.name: Kopili
formations.description: Kopili shale is a thick, regionally extensive seal formation. It is characterized by very low permeability and high in-situ stresses that make cementing problematic due to formation ballooning. NPT events are common from equipment failures in this interval.

formations.name: Sylhet
formations.description: Sylhet limestone is a carbonate reservoir with naturally fractured zones. Abnormal pore pressure gradients are common due to isolated pressure compartments within the carbonate matrix. BHA failures in the hard carbonate lead to fishing operations.

formations.name: Langpur
formations.description: Langpur sandstone is a shallow, high-porosity formation with very good reservoir quality. The unconsolidated nature of shallow Langpur sands causes wellbore instability and mud losses at the transition to deeper formations. Junk losses and fishing operations are also recorded.

formations.name: Namsang
formations.description: Namsang formation is a turbidite sequence with rapidly alternating sandstone and shale layers. The high degree of heterogeneity causes reactive shale swelling, leading to torque spikes and tight-hole conditions. Cement channeling is common due to poor standoff in deviated wells.

formations.name: Girujan
formations.description: Girujan formation is a shallow, unconsolidated sandstone at relatively low depth. It requires minimal mud weight but can have lost circulation due to its high permeability. Cementation of surface casing through Girujan needs careful monitoring.

formations.name: Bokabil
formations.description: Bokabil formation contains alternating sandstone-shale sequences with occasional coal seams. The coal seams can cause tool-related NPT and mud losses when intersected at high angles. Tight hole conditions frequently observed in the shale-dominant intervals.

formations.name: Bhuban
formations.description: Bhuban formation is a deep, thick sandstone reservoir with significant overpressure potential. It is a key exploration target in the sub-thrust belt of the Assam-Arakan Basin. Well control events and stuck pipe incidents are frequent due to pressure uncertainties.

formations.name: Surma
formations.description: Surma formation represents the deepest commercial target in the Assam Basin. It is characterized by tight limestone-shale alternations with very high formation pressures. Cementing is extremely challenging due to narrow safe mud weight windows.

events.description: Partial mud loss at 3120m in Tipam fractured zone. Returns dropped 60% over 40 minutes. 3 LCM pills pumped (50kg each). Returns restored after 8.5 hours.
events.root_cause: Fractured Tipam sandstone at 3120m — same fractured horizon observed in X101, X102, X106. Formation pressure window narrow (0.8 ppg).
events.mitigation: LCM pill (coarse nut plug + CaCO3) pumped. Mud weight reduced from 10.9 to 10.6 ppg. Blind drilling avoided.

events.description: Differential sticking at 3280-3298m in Tipam permeable sandstone. Overbalance at 450 psi exceeded safe limit. Pipe rotation lost. Jar down operations initiated after 2 hours.
events.root_cause: High differential pressure across high-permeability Tipam sandstone at 3280m. Mud cake thickness 12mm. Overbalance 450 psi (recommended max: 300 psi).
events.mitigation: 500L diesel-base spotting pill placed around stuck interval over 3 hours. Jar down + rotation freed pipe after 16 hours NPT. Mud weight reduced 0.2 ppg post-incident.

events.description: Torque spikes to 24 kNm observed at 3450m in inter-bedded Tipam shale-sand sequence. Normal torque 18 kNm. Reaming required for 4 hours before drilling resumed.
events.root_cause: Reactive shale swelling in Tipam inter-beds. Wellbore diameter reduced below gauge. Borehole ellipticity due to anisotropic stress regime.
events.mitigation: Torque-reduction lubricant added to mud system (10 L/m³). Reaming with reduced WOB. RPM increased from 100 to 125 rpm to break out tight spots.

events.description: Mud pump liner failure at 2950m. Operations suspended for 3.5 hours. Liner replaced and pressure tested before resuming.
events.root_cause: Pump liner wear exceeded replacement threshold. Maintenance interval not adjusted for high-solids mud.
events.mitigation: Emergency liner replacement from rig spares. Hydraulics re-checked. Pump inspection schedule revised to 200-hour intervals.

events.description: CBL/VDL log showed channeling on production casing cement at 3720-3760m. Free pipe indication over 40m. Squeeze job performed.
events.root_cause: Mud contamination of lead cement slurry. Inadequate hole conditioning — 4 circulations recommended, only 2 done.
events.mitigation: Selective squeeze cementing at 3725m and 3750m perforations. CBL re-run confirmed improved bond. Well put on production.

events.description: Partial mud loss at 3095m. Same fractured Tipam horizon as X104 (drilled 10 months later). Returns reduced by 50%. LCM treatment successful.
events.root_cause: Same fractured Tipam zone intersected at 3095m. Regional fracture network confirmed by two wells (X101 + X104).
events.mitigation: LCM pill pumped. Mud weight reduced. Circulation restored after 6.5 hours.

events.description: Severe differential sticking at 3210m in Tipam sandstone. 18 hours NPT. Spotting oil pill placed after 4 hours. Pipe freed after jar down combined with chemical treatment.
events.root_cause: High overbalance (480 psi) in high-permeability Tipam sandstone. Differential sticking pattern consistent with X104.
events.mitigation: Oil pill spotted. Jar operations (down). Pressure surge. Pipe freed after 18 hrs. Mud weight protocol revised.

events.description: Intermittent torque spikes from 3380m onwards in reactive Tipam shale inter-beds. Managed with reaming and lubricant addition.
events.root_cause: Reactive shale swelling. Consistent with X104 torque events at similar depth.
events.mitigation: Lubricant concentration increased. Reaming on trips. Acceptable drilling progress maintained.

events.description: Top-drive gearbox failure at 3500m. Operations suspended 4 hours. Standby top-drive engaged.
events.root_cause: Equipment fatigue. Inspection interval exceeded.
events.mitigation: Gearbox replaced. Preventive maintenance schedule updated.

events.description: Partial mud loss at 3130m. Vertical trajectory meant lower overbalance — losses moderate and recovered with one LCM treatment.
events.root_cause: Same Tipam fractured zone at 3130m. Vertical well reduces differential pressure compared to deviated wells.
events.mitigation: Single LCM pill restored circulation within 4 hours.

events.description: Poor cement bond log at 2900-2950m on intermediate casing. Channeling over 50m interval. Remedial squeeze performed.
events.root_cause: Mud contamination of cement during displacement. Spacer volume insufficient.
events.mitigation: Squeeze cementing at 2910m and 2940m. CBL improved post-squeeze.

events.description: Rig down due to mud pit maintenance at 3300m. 3 hours NPT.
events.root_cause: Scheduled maintenance delayed. Pit agitator failure.
events.mitigation: Agitator replaced. Pit maintenance rescheduled.

events.description: Gas kick at 3550m entering Barail sandstone. Pit gain 2.4 m³ over 12 minutes. Well shut-in. SIDPP 350 psi. Driller's method kill — circulated kill mud at 12.2 ppg.
events.root_cause: Pore pressure ramp-up in Barail not anticipated. Pre-drill model underestimated pressure by 1.2 ppg.
events.mitigation: Driller's method kill. Mud weight raised from 11.2 to 12.2 ppg. Choke managed. Kill complete after 22 hours.

events.description: Torque spikes to 22 kNm in Barail shale interval at 3620m. Formation anisotropy causing string vibration.
events.root_cause: Barail formation anisotropy — high tectonic stress. Borehole deviation 18° increasing contact forces.
events.mitigation: Reduced drilling parameters. Reaming on connections. Progress continued after 5 hrs adjustment.

events.description: Overpressure zone at 3800m in deep Barail sandstone. Formation pressure gradient 0.78 psi/ft. Mud weight increase from 12.2 to 13.0 ppg required.
events.root_cause: Overpressure compartment in deep Barail — pressure seal above prevents pressure equilibration.
events.mitigation: Incremental mud weight increases (0.2 ppg steps). 14 hours NPT for kill mud mixing and conditioning.

events.description: MWD tool failure at 3950m. Survey data lost over 200m interval. Back-reaming required for tool replacement.
events.root_cause: MWD shock and vibration damage. High torque/vibration environment in deep Barail.
events.mitigation: Tool retrieved and replaced. Survey re-run. Vibration dampening subs added to BHA.

events.description: Torque spikes 3150-3200m in reactive Namsang shale. Turbidite sequence causing intermittent tight hole.
events.root_cause: Reactive Namsang shale swelling. Similar mechanism to Tipam inter-beds in X104.
events.mitigation: Lubricant pill. Reaming. Drilling continued with reduced parameters.

events.description: Minor cement channeling on production casing at 3300-3350m in Namsang formation. CBL showed intermittent bond.
events.root_cause: Poor centralization in deviated Namsang interval. Side-loading reduced cement coverage.
events.mitigation: Micro-annulus cement. Acceptable for production operations. No squeeze required.

events.description: Minor mud loss at 3080m at Langpur-Namsang transition. Controlled with LCM addition.
events.root_cause: Formation boundary — unconsolidated Langpur sand below Namsang.
events.mitigation: LCM pill — bridging material. Recovered in 2.5 hours.

events.description: Mud loss at 3090m — confirms the Tipam fractured zone is regional (X101: 3095m, X104: 3120m, X106: 3090m). Triangulated fracture system at depth ~3090-3130m.
events.root_cause: Regional Tipam fracture network. 3 wells confirm this is a consistent risk horizon.
events.mitigation: LCM treatment. Mud weight reduced. Returns restored.

events.description: CRITICAL stuck pipe at 3260-3290m. Worst case in this field area — 24 hrs NPT. Overbalance 520 psi. Near-vertical differential sticking. Emergency oil pill.
events.root_cause: Highest overbalance of any X106 section. Drill string against formation wall. Maximum sticking force.
events.mitigation: Large volume oil pill (800L). Jar down with maximum jar load. String freed after 24 hrs. Near-sidetrack decision reached.

events.description: Generator failure at 3180m. Standby generator brought online. 3.5 hours NPT.
events.root_cause: Generator overload due to parallel high-consumption equipment.
events.mitigation: Load management improved. Standby generator always on hot standby.

events.description: CRITICAL gas kick in Barail horizontal section at 3900m. Pit gain 4.2 m³. Formation pressure significantly underestimated in horizontal. Well control emergency. 30 hours NPT.
events.root_cause: Horizontal wellbore ECD effects masked true bottomhole pressure. Pore pressure model not calibrated for horizontal wellbore in Barail.
events.mitigation: Emergency well control. Driller's method kill. Kill mud density 13.5 ppg. Additional mud weight added beyond pre-drill model.

events.description: BHA failure in Barail horizontal section at 4100m. Drill collar parted at tool joint. Fishing operations required 40 hours. Overshot deployed × 3 attempts.
events.root_cause: Fatigue failure of drill collar connection. High-vibration environment in Barail horizontal with stick-slip.
events.mitigation: Overshot successfully engaged on run 3. Component retrieved. Premium connections specified for future horizontal runs.

events.description: Secondary overpressure zone at 4150m in Barail horizontal extension. Mud weight required further increase.
events.root_cause: Second pressure compartment encountered in deep Barail horizontal.
events.mitigation: Mud weight increased to 13.8 ppg. Drilling continued.

events.description: Mud loss at 2950m in unconsolidated Langpur sandstone. Shallow losses — easily controlled with LCM and mud weight reduction.
events.root_cause: Unconsolidated Langpur sand with high permeability and natural fractures.
events.mitigation: LCM pill. Mud weight reduced 0.3 ppg. Losses stopped.

events.description: Junk in hole at 3050m from prior operation debris (previous well). Junk basket deployed. 20 hours NPT. Magnet recovered metal fragments.
events.root_cause: Metal debris from previous workover operation not fully cleaned. Inadequate wellbore survey before drilling.
events.mitigation: Junk basket + magnet assembly. 3 clean-out runs required. Debris fully recovered.

events.description: Shaker screen replacement at 2800m. Routine maintenance took 2.5 hours at shift change.
events.root_cause: Shaker screens worn — expected at this depth interval.
events.mitigation: Screens replaced. No further action required.

events.description: Partial mud loss encountered in fractured zone at 1800m. Returns decreased by 60%. LCM pill pumped immediately.
events.root_cause: Fractured formation with insufficient mud weight differential control. Natural fracture network intersected at depth.
events.mitigation: LCM pill pumped. Bridging material used. Mud weight adjusted downwards by 0.3 ppg. Drill-in fluid prepared as contingency.

events.description: Differential sticking observed at 1800m. High overbalance in Tipam permeable sandstone. Pipe could not be rotated.
events.root_cause: High differential pressure across permeable formation with thick filter cake. Overbalance exceeded safe threshold.
events.mitigation: Back-off initiated. Jar down operations activated. Spotting oil pill around stuck interval. 500L oil-base pill spotted.

[Synthetic Demo Data — Not Real OIL Data]
Field: Duliajan Field | Operator: Oil India Limited
Rig: DKB-350 | Total Depth: 3850m | Primary Formation: Tipam
Final Mud Weight at TD: 10.9 ppg

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY:
Well OIL-X104 was drilled to a total depth of 3850m in the Tipam formation,
Duliajan Field, Assam Basin. The well encountered the primary reservoir target
as prognosed with good formation evaluation results.

DRILLING HAZARDS ENCOUNTERED:
1. MUD LOSS at 3118m — Severity: MEDIUM
   Cause: Fractured Tipam sandstone. Regional fracture network confirmed by
   adjacent wells X101, X104, X106 at similar depths (3090-3130m interval).
   Action: LCM pill treatment. Returns restored. No wellbore integrity issues.

2. STUCK PIPE at 3272m — Severity: HIGH
   Cause: Differential sticking in high-permeability Tipam sandstone.
   Overbalance reached 450 psi. High filtercake thickness contributed.
   Action: Spotting oil pill. Jar operations. Pipe freed after 16 hrs NPT.
   Impact: 16 hours NPT. Cost: ~₹18.5 lakhs equivalent.

3. TORQUE SPIKE at 3446m — Severity: MEDIUM
   Cause: Reactive shale swelling in Tipam inter-beds.
   Action: Lubricant addition. Reaming. 4 hrs NPT.

FORMATION EVALUATION:
Reservoir quality (pay zone 3670m — 3810m):
  Porosity:       18-22% (average 20.5%)
  Permeability:   85-130 mD (average 107 mD)
  Water saturation: 28-35%
  Net pay:        -140m gross, ~62% NTG

CEMENTING:
- Surface casing cement: Good bond. No remedial action.
- Intermediate cement: Good bond overall. Minor channeling at 2150m — acceptable.
- Production casing: Channeling at 3720m on CBL. Squeeze job performed.
  Post-squeeze CBL confirmed satisfactory bond.

COMPLETION RECOMMENDATION: Perforate Tipam pay zone 3690m — 3790m.

LESSONS LEARNED:
1. MUD LOSS RISK: Tipam fractured zone at 3090-3130m is now confirmed in 4 wells
   (X101, X102, X104, X106). Recommend proactive LCM pill before entering 3050m.

2. STUCK PIPE RISK: Overbalance > 400 psi in Tipam permeable sandstone (3200-3300m)
   leads to differential sticking. Recommend reducing mud weight by 0.2 ppg at 3150m
   and spotting 300L lubricant pill at 3200m as preventive measure.

3. TORQUE MANAGEMENT: Reactive Tipam shale at 3400-3500m requires lubricant standby
   and increased ream frequency.

4. OVERALL: Review this WCR before drilling any new well in Duliajan targeting Tipam
   below 3000m. Particularly relevant for OIL-X123 (currently drilling).

POST-INCIDENT REPORT — Stuck Pipe Incident — OIL-X106
[Synthetic Demo Data — Not Real OIL Data]
Date: 2022-02-01 | Severity: CRITICAL | NPT: 24.0 hours
Well: OIL-X106 | Depth: 3260m — 3290m | Formation: Tipam

INCIDENT SUMMARY:
A critical stuck pipe incident occurred at 3260m
in the Tipam formation during drilling operations. The incident resulted in
24.0 hours of non-productive time.

ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS (5-Why):
1. Why did stuck pipe occur?
   → High differential pressure / formation pressure exceeded mud hydrostatics.
2. Why was differential pressure high?
   → Mud weight not reduced prior to entering high-permeability / overpressured zone.
3. Why was mud weight not reduced?

risk_zones.explanation: 4 offset wells experienced mud losses in the 3090-3155m interval. X104 (3120m, MEDIUM, 8.5 hrs NPT), X101 (3095m, MEDIUM, 6.5 hrs NPT), X102 (3130m, LOW, 4.0 hrs NPT), X106 (3090m, MEDIUM, 7.0 hrs NPT). Regional Tipam fracture network confirmed at this depth. Proactive LCM staging recommended before 3050m.

3 high-similarity offset wells experienced stuck-pipe incidents in the 3180-3310m interval. X104 (3280-3298m, HIGH, 16 hrs NPT), X101 (3210-3240m, HIGH, 18 hrs NPT), X106 (3260-3290m, CRITICAL, 24 hrs NPT). Root cause: differential sticking in high-permeability Tipam sandstone. Overbalance >400 psi is the trigger. Recommend spotting 300L lubricant pill at 3180m and reducing mud weight by 0.2 ppg before entering this zone.

3 offset wells experienced torque spikes in the 3380-3520m depth range. X104 (3450-3470m, MEDIUM, 4 hrs NPT), X101 (3380-3420m, LOW, 2.5 hrs NPT), X105 (3150-3200m in Namsang — similar reactive shale mechanism). Reactive shale swelling in Tipam inter-beds reduces wellbore diameter. Recommend lubrication pill and increased ream frequency from 3350m.

2 offset wells experienced cementing issues near production casing depth. X104 (3720-3760m, channeling, squeeze required), X102 (2900-2950m intermediate casing). Fractured Tipam at this depth absorbs cement. Recommend increasing spacer volume and centralizer count for production casing cement job.

3 wells reported minor NPT events (equipment maintenance, screen changes) in the 2800-3000m Langpur interval. Low risk — routine maintenance NPT. No structural hazard. Schedule maintenance activities before entering this interval.

2 wells reported minor mud losses in Langpur shallow sandstone. X108 (2950m, LOW) and X105 (3080m Langpur-Namsang boundary, LOW). Unconsolidated Langpur sand prone to minor losses at formation boundaries. Ensure LCM is pre-positioned before crossing 2900m.

At depths below 3600m, Tipam transitions toward Barail overpressure regime. X103 encountered pore pressure ramp at 3550m in nearby Barail well. Monitor D-exponent from 3550m onwards. If anomaly detected, pause and assess.

If OIL-X123 penetrates into Barail formation below 3750m, kick risk is HIGH. X103 experienced gas kick at 3550m and X107 had critical kick at 3900m. Barail is overpressured in this area. Ensure mud weight ≥ 12.0 ppg before 3750m. Well control equipment to be tested at 3700m.
Shallow sticking risk in Girujan clay-rich sandstone. Low probability. Monitor drag while pulling out of intermediate casing shoe.
Bokabil sandstone at 2400-2500m occasionally has minor partial losses. Low severity. Have LCM on standby.
Minor torque anomalies in Bokabil coal-bearing interval. Typically self-resolving with reduced WOB.
Equipment-related NPT common in this depth range — pump and MWD tool maintenance.
Intermediate casing cement quality in Girujan interval historically variable. Recommend additional centralizers and longer pre-flush.
Secondary fracture zone in upper Tipam at 3310-3380m. Observed in X101 as minor losses while pulling out.
Lower Tipam sandstone continues to be a differential sticking risk. Single evidence well (X104) shows similar sand at this depth. Maintain lubricant concentration.
Junk-in-hole risk from historical fishing operations in the area. Low probability for new wells with clean wellbore.
Deep Barail overpressure at TD. X103 (3800m) and X107 (4150m) both encountered overpressure compartments. Mud weight ≥ 13.0 ppg required.
Torque anomalies in deep Tipam-Barail transition zone. X103 showed torque spikes at 3620m. Inter-bedded reactive shale.
Minor NPT events (pump maintenance, equipment checks) recorded in X104 and X101 at this depth. Timing risk — plan maintenance before entering this zone.
Barail entry at ~3550m is where X103 experienced a gas kick. Monitor gas units and pit volume continuously below 3500m.
Cement quality risk in the fractured Tipam interval. X102 had intermediate casing channeling in this region. Use anti-channeling cement additive.
